visualCharacteristics: 3-up wrapping grid, white card with shadow, image on top with navy bottom rule, eyebrow, bold title, description, navy arrow at bottom; whole card is one link
contentPattern: One row per card. Column 1: card image. Column 2: optional eyebrow paragraph, H3 title, description paragraph, link to the detail page.

usage.description: Grids of image cards that each link to a detail page, such as business support services or programs (3 or 6 cards per grid).

reuseGuidance: Use when every card has an image and leads to its own page. For text-only link cards use cards-link-tile.
